sidebar.resizeHint: Drag to resize. Double-click to collapse or expand.

detail.pipelineFailedPendingTitle: Pipeline failed before this phase could finish
detail.pipelineFailedPendingSubtitle: The run was stopped (timeout, error, or worker interruption). Retry restarts from the last recorded phase on the server. If a specific domain shows Failed in the sidebar, open that phase and use Retry there.
detail.domainUnavailableBody: This domain could not be analysed. The pipeline has continued and the Strategy Agent will note this gap explicitly.
detail.resumeCancelledPlatformHint: Platform only: clears cancelled status so the owner can retry the current phase or press Continue.
detail.pipelineCancelledConsultantBody: Start, Continue, and Retry are disabled while the audit is cancelled. Ask a platform administrator to reopen the pipeline, or use the support flow your organization agreed on.
detail.stopPipelineConfirm: Stop this pipeline now? The status will change to cancelled.
detail.governanceRefineBody: Confidence and claim checks suggest refining this phase output before relying on it in downstream analysis.
detail.governanceWarningsBody: Output was saved. Review the governance summary below before the next wing.
detail.reconPreviewIntroBody: This is the saved crawl output used as context for later phases. You can review it here before opening Approve in the sidebar after phase 0.
detail.clientReviewGateBody: The audit is paused at a review checkpoint. Your consultant must approve this stage before the next steps can run. You do not need to take action here unless they ask you for something. Keep this page open if you like — it will update when the run continues.

reviewModal.strategyReviseHint: If you add consultant or client notes and approve, the Strategy phase runs again so the roadmap incorporates your corrections, then this gate reopens. If you have no changes, leave notes empty and approve to mark the audit complete.
reviewModal.governanceRefineSectionIntro: The Decision Layer recommended refine for the following completed phases. The pipeline continued; use notes below to capture context before approving.
reviewModal.reconSnapshotCorrectionHint: The recon table above is a saved crawler snapshot — it does not update while you type. If anything is wrong (for example a social profile, contact, or page signal), write the correction in Consultant notes below. Approved notes override conflicting automation for all later phases and the report.
reviewModal.laterGateCorrectionHint: Earlier phases may have mis-detected facts (recon, forms, mobile, social, etc.). Use Consultant notes below to state corrections — they are treated as ground truth for Marketing, Automation, Strategy, and the exported report.

recon.introBody: Downstream audit phases use this saved reconnaissance snapshot as context. Confirm the crawl coverage and extracted signals look reasonable before continuing.
recon.truncationWarningTitle: Context was trimmed for the model
recon.truncationWarningBody: Some crawler content was truncated when building the AI context. URLs and summaries below still reflect what was stored from the crawl.
recon.extractionNoteBody: Emails and phone numbers are parsed from public pages and may include form placeholders or noise. Verify before relying on them.
recon.missingDataBody: Try refreshing the page. If this persists, recon may not have been saved yet — check the pipeline log or retry phase 0.
recon.emptyTech: No tech signals were recorded in recon.
recon.emptyContact: No contacts or social profiles were extracted.
recon.emptyPages: No pages were recorded in recon.

revBanner.noNotesSaved: No notes were saved for this gate (optional).
